name: bada-quantos
description: Bada QuantOS — a pseudo-quantum-computer operating system whose kernel is a generative AI. Tablet/smartphone functions (phone line via tel:/sms:/mailto: intents, camera, clock, calculator, notes, files, contacts) are ported through a topological mapping mechanism: each function is classified by its knot's Kauffman bracket invariant and injectively mapped onto the basis states of a 4-qubit register simulated by the quantum Bada engine. Self-contained HTML app.
author: Masaaki Yamaguchi
